connector.name: Delora MCP
connector.registryDescription: Delora MCP server for cross-chain quotes, supported chains, tokens, and tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.delora.build over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the deloraprotocol account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.description: Optional Delora API key forwarded to Delora API.

env.name: DELORA_API_KEY
env.description: Optional Delora API key forwarded to Delora API as x-api-key.
